tasks.AssessCourseRequirements: Evaluate the specific course requirements for daily book carriage.
tasks.CheckUniversityPolicies: Examine the university policies regarding student responsibilities and expected behaviors related to carrying books.
tasks.ConsiderInstructorExpectations: Understand what instructors expect from students in terms of preparation for classes.
tasks.EvaluatePersonalResponsibility: Assess individual student responsibilities and time management skills related to managing study materials.
tasks.ObservePeerBehavior: Observe common practices and norms among students regarding carrying books.
tasks.ReviewStudentSupportServices: Determine if there are adequate resources such as libraries or digital access that can reduce the need to carry physical books all day.
